name: Open a savings account
description: A savings account holds your money and pays interest.
how_it_works: You apply online with Aadhaar and PAN, verify by OTP and video call, and the bank activates the account.

name: Open a current account
description: A current account suits businesses with many daily transactions.
how_it_works: The bank checks your business documents and KYC before opening the account.

name: Open a fixed deposit
description: A fixed deposit locks money for a fixed period at a set rate.
how_it_works: You choose the amount and period, confirm with OTP, and the bank debits your account.

name: Start a recurring deposit
description: A recurring deposit saves a fixed amount every month.
how_it_works: You set a monthly amount and period. The bank debits it automatically each month.

name: Block a lost or stolen card
description: Blocking stops anyone from using a lost or stolen card.
how_it_works: You tell the bank which card and why. The bank blocks it at once and informs the card networks.

name: Request a new debit card
description: A debit card lets you withdraw cash and pay at shops and online.
how_it_works: You request a card from your account. The bank prints it and posts it to your address.

name: Apply for a credit card
description: A credit card lets you spend now and pay later within a limit.
how_it_works: The bank checks your income and credit history, then decides the limit.

name: Create a virtual card
description: A virtual card is a digital card number for safer online payments.
how_it_works: You create it inside the bank app and can set a limit or delete it.

name: Link PAN to my bank account
steps: Log in or visit the branch
description: Banks need your PAN on record for tax rules and refunds.
how_it_works: You submit your PAN in the bank app or at the branch. The bank checks it and links it to your account.

name: Apply for a new PAN card
steps: Go to the official NSDL or UTIITSL portal
Pay the fee and track the status
description: A new PAN card is issued by the government, not by the bank.
how_it_works: You apply on the official NSDL or UTIITSL portal and track the status there.

name: Correct details on my PAN card
steps: Go to the official PAN correction service
Update the bank after the new card arrives
description: Corrections to the data on a PAN card are made through the government portal.
how_it_works: You submit the correction with proof on the official portal. Tell your bank after the new card arrives.

name: Change my address
steps: Verify with Aadhaar OTP or upload proof
description: The bank must hold your current address for statements and cards.
how_it_works: You verify with Aadhaar OTP or upload address proof. The bank checks it and updates the record.

name: Update my mobile number
steps: Confirm with OTP on the new number
description: Your mobile number receives OTPs and alerts, so it must be correct.
how_it_works: You request the change and verify your identity. The bank confirms with an OTP on the new number.

name: Correct my date of birth
description: A wrong date of birth can block loans and pension work.
how_it_works: You submit age proof and a request. The bank verifies it and corrects the record, often at the branch.

name: Update my KYC details
steps: Upload documents and confirm with OTP
description: KYC keeps your identity and address details current as the rules require.
how_it_works: You review your details, upload documents and confirm with OTP. The bank re checks them.

name: Set up UPI
description: UPI sends money instantly using your mobile number or QR code.
how_it_works: You install a UPI app, link your bank account with your debit card details, and set a UPI PIN.

name: Transfer money (NEFT, RTGS, IMPS)
description: NEFT, RTGS and IMPS move money between bank accounts.
how_it_works: You add the payee, enter the amount and confirm with OTP. IMPS is instant, NEFT runs in batches and RTGS suits large amounts.

name: Pay bills and recharge
description: Bill pay settles electricity, water, mobile and similar bills from your account.
how_it_works: The bank fetches the bill from the biller, you confirm, and the amount is debited and sent to the biller.

name: Apply for a loan
description: A loan application lets the bank check if you qualify for credit.
how_it_works: You check eligibility, prepare documents and apply. The bank verifies and then sanctions or declines.

name: Understand overdraft
description: An overdraft lets you go below zero up to a limit.
how_it_works: The bank sets a limit on your account. You pay interest only on the amount you use.

name: Request a safe deposit locker
description: A locker keeps jewellery and papers safe inside the bank vault.
how_it_works: You request a locker, the branch confirms availability, and you sign an agreement and pay yearly rent.

name: Set up mobile banking
description: Mobile banking lets you check balances and pay from your phone.
how_it_works: You install the official app, register with an OTP sent to your mobile, and set a login PIN.

name: Learn about insurance
description: Insurance pays out when a covered loss happens.
how_it_works: You pay a premium. The insurer pays the claim as per the policy terms.

name: Learn about mutual funds and demat
description: Mutual funds pool money from many people to invest in markets, and a demat account holds shares.
how_it_works: You complete KYC, choose a fund or open a demat account, and invest. Returns are not guaranteed.

name: File a complaint
steps: Get a ticket number and track it
description: A complaint tells the bank about a problem you want fixed.
how_it_works: You describe the issue and get a ticket number. The bank must respond within its stated time and can escalate if unresolved.
